export function slugify(title) {
  return title
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, "")      // strip non-letter/digit/hyphen chars
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-")              // collapse whitespace runs to single hyphen
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");            // trim leading/trailing hyphens
}
